help.title: Help
help.section1Body: A tool that extracts text from images or PDFs and organizes it into Markdown. Convert worksheets, notices, and scripts into digital documents.
help.step1: Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WEBP) or PDF, or paste with Ctrl+V.
help.step2: OCR automatically extracts and formats the text.
help.section3Body: A simple way to format text with special characters. Easy to learn!
help.section4Body: Listen to results using browser speech. Play/pause/stop and speed control available. Markdown symbols are auto-removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aiSectionBody: Refine OCR output once more with Google AI Studio (Gemini). It fixes spacing, typos, and mixed-language (English/Japanese) recognition errors while preserving the original line breaks. To use it, first deploy a proxy with your own free API key (see the worker folder).
settings.urlHint: Enter the proxy URL you deployed (e.g. a Cloudflare Worker). Your API key is never stored in this browser — it stays only on the proxy server.
settings.needUrl: A proxy URL is required to enable AI correction.
settings.aiFailed: AI correction failed — showing the raw result.
